exploratory_ctx.scope: variantes de MLP con ventana de contexto (Seccion 4.3.2 del manuscrito), anadidas en la revision. Fuera del plan fijado: no entran en S*_d, ni en H1-H4, ni en R1.4, ni en SD_pool, ni en las ablaciones §7-§8. La comparacion con C9 es descriptiva.
exploratory_ctx.disclosure_required: The benign training stretch is selected with the true labels; it is not a label-free warm-up. This applies as it does to T1-T4 (pipeline 'corrected'; on CIC/ACI the labels check that the training interval holds no attack row, and none is removed). No figure of C12-C15 may be presented as an operational zero-day result or described as 'label-free' without this statement beside it.
exploratory_ctx.headline_rule: No pre-registered rule says which of C12-C15 is the figure of the manuscript: the four configurations are reported on all the datasets and the best one is not chosen a posteriori.

exploratory_inventory.rule: §11/§12.1: each comparison of C12-C15 against C9 is a descriptive exploratory analysis. All the configurations and all the datasets of the manifest are published (a configuration without a value is listed with a state other than DONE; it is not dropped). No test, no confidence interval and no adjustment for multiplicity. This count is reported beside any figure of C12-C15.

implementation_notes: AG-1 (§4.3, §4.5) C9 (MLP) is the mean of the AR and TSR replicas with the same seed; if either of the two is a lost cell, C9 is a lost cell (it is not replaced by the remaining replica, which would be another estimator). A replica that was not run shortens S*_d like any other cell, unless its sibling is a lost cell: C9 is then already lost and the remaining replica contributes to no test, so it counts as lost for the prefix (ST-m5).

AG-2 (§4.5) 'cell' = row of the manifest per (variant, paradigm) across the seeds. S*_d is the largest k in {3, 2, 1, 0} such that, with lost = cells FAILED/BLOCKED/not executable/removed by the contingency sequence in some seed of (A, B, C)[:k], all the others have DONE with a valid metrics.json in every seed of the prefix. original/stat: their single run (seed A) stands for every seed; if it was not run it shortens every prefix.

AG-3 (§4.5, §12.2) a DONE job without a valid metrics.json (absent, different schema or state, different plan or inputs, non-finite primary) counts as not finished for S*_d (it shortens the prefix) and is listed; aggregate exits with code 1. A metrics.json with section_errors (sensitivity sections, T4-P, T4-E or S-DUPCAL) is valid for the primary: only those sections are NA, a warning is issued and aggregate.complete = false (stats.py then runs on partial inputs) until the metrics are recomputed (F-04).

AG-4 (§12.2, §13.3) escalera: --ladder-json lista job_ids eliminados. En T2-T4 son celdas perdidas (en todas las semillas); en T1 (escalones 5, 6 y 10: semilla C o B no ejecutada) cuentan como no ejecutadas y acortan S*_d.

AG-5 (§12.2) divergencia (nonfinite.divergent): en los analisis confirmatorios se usan divergence.imputed_itt (ROC-AUC FUS 0,5; AUC_loc(RAW) 0,5; PR-AUC p; F1 0) y, por la misma regla 'ROC-AUC = 0,5', ROC-AUC de KMD_f y MVD_f = 0,5 (entran en H3). La sensibilidad 'sin imputar' (s_div_noimp) elimina la celda por comparacion.

AG-6 (§12.2 S-ITT) celdas perdidas imputadas con ROC-AUC = 0,5 (FUS, KMD_f, MVD_f); el resto de metricas de la celda quedan sin valor (AUC_loc no se imputa: la regla de robustez §5.8 no se aplica a sensibilidades).
AG-7 (§4.5 S-SEED) prefijo comun L = min_d |S*_d| sobre los 9 datasets con el MISMO conjunto de celdas perdidas del analisis principal; si algun dataset tiene |S*_d| = 0, S-SEED no es calculable.

AG-8 (§7.1) referencia de una ablacion = el job de la rejilla T1 del bloque de referencia (T1-A; T1-B para T2-B) con el mismo dataset, variante y paradigma (MLP de T3: la replica AR, no C9); en T4-E la referencia c = 0 es t4e_reference de ese job. Delta = ablacion - referencia (ROC-AUC de FUS; PR-AUC y F1 como secundarias).

AG-9 (§7.1) SD_pool(d)^2 = media de las varianzas entre semillas (ddof = 1, sobre S*_d) de ROC-AUC de FUS de las configuraciones C1-C9 no perdidas (C9: media de replicas por semilla) con los valores SIN imputar: las ablaciones son descriptivas y la ITT de §12.2 solo rige en los analisis confirmatorios; las semillas divergidas se excluyen de la varianza de su configuracion (hacen falta >= 2 semillas); gl = sum_c (n_semillas_c - 1). La SD y el min-max de cada celda usan esos mismos valores; la version con ITT se reporta aparte (sufijo _itt). Umbral = max(sqrt(2) SD_pool(d), 0,01); 0,01 en original/stat y si |S*_d| = 1. En T3 la MLP es una sola replica (AR) y su umbral usa SD_pool calculado con C9 (media de 2 replicas), que infraestima el ruido de una replica: se declara y cada celda MLP de T3 lleva |Delta_MLP| de la semilla A (ruido entre replicas, §3.2) al lado (ST-m7).

AG-10 (§12.2) solo cuentan los metrics.json con el mismo metrics_rev_sha256 y los mismos helpers_sha256 (metrics_rev.py, common.py y pipelines.py: la logica de regiones y de F_cal vive en los auxiliares; F-05). Un cambio exige recalculo completo (§14.2): si hay mezcla, aggregate lo marca como error de consistencia y stats.py se niega a correr.

AG-11 (§4.5 'at the freeze of the results') a T1-T4 job whose DONE is later than --freeze (default common.FREEZE = 2026-09-30 23:59:59, local time; time of the DONE = its ISO content written by the runner or, if it cannot be read, its mtime) had not finished at the freeze: it shortens S*_d like a cell that was not run, enters no value set and no ablation as confirmatory, and is listed in runs.csv as [EXPLORATORIO] post-freeze (ST-M4).
AG-12 (§4.3) original/stat: el valor de la celda es el de su UNICA ejecucion (semilla A), no la media de |S*_d| copias identicas (que puede diferir en 1 ulp y crear o romper empates; ST-m3).

AG-13 (§3.6, §14.1) las cotas O2 van en runs.csv en filas propias (analysis = 'O2', etiqueta [ORACULO]); las filas 'main' no llevan columnas oraculo (F-03). Una fila por intento conservado (analysis = 'attempt', §4.6; ST-m9).

AG-14 (§14.4 hito (i), §6.1) la hora del primer metrics.json (global y por dataset) es el minimo del registro append-only de metrics_rev (.metrics_rev/, MR-12), de su log y de los 'created' de los metrics.json agregados (F-10); stats.py la usa en la guarda de D (ST-M3).

AG-15 (outside the frozen plan) the blocks T7-MLPW and T7-MLPDEEP (variants 'mlp_ctx' and 'mlp_deep_ctx', configurations C12-C15) are [EXPLORATORIO]: they are loaded into a collection of their own (load_ctx_jobs) and do not enter A.jobs, cells, S*_d, SD_pool, value_sets, the ablations of §7-§8, 'counts' or 'complete' (a T7 cell without a value blocks nothing confirmatory). They are published in aggregate.json['exploratory_ctx'] and in rows of runs.csv with in_S_star = false and the label [EXPLORATORIO]. AR and TSR are not averaged (unlike C9): these variants do read the window, so each paradigm is recorded as a separate configuration, as in C1-C8. Note: it was measured that in 'mlp_ctx' with L = 800 AR and TSR are almost the same estimator (rank correlation 0.99973 on real data), so C12 and C13 cannot support any claim. The comparison with C9 of the same dataset is descriptive and is always published with noise_threshold and abs_delta_MLP_seedA beside it: the main reference is C9 of the same seed (A), not the mean over S*_d.
